gate_documented_seam_lt_1cm.note: NOT MET. At 20 fps a swinging foot covers ~12 cm per frame, and the SAME extrapolation test applied inside the cycle scores 0.111 m -- so a 1 cm absolute gate is stricter than the motion itself and cannot be met by any crop of this source.

gate_proposed_seam_no_worse_than_interio.rationale: A loop reads as continuous when the wrap frame is no more abrupt than a normal frame of the same motion. This is resolution- and speed-independent, unlike a fixed distance. PROPOSED -- awaiting approval; the documented 1 cm figure is reported above unchanged.
